question: How many net tons will most vessels more than 25 feet in length measure?
source_quote: Most vessels more than 25 feet in length will measure five net tons or more.

question: What minimum height must the letters of the name and hailing port be?
source_quote: Use letters not less than 4 inches in height.

question: During cold incapacitation, within how many minutes will you lose the effective use of your fingers, arms, and legs?
source_quote: in the next 10 minutes you will lose the effective use of your fingers, arms, and legs for any meaningful movement.

question: Under the International Rules, what must a pilot vessel exhibit when not engaged on pilotage duty?
expected_answer: The lights or shapes prescribed for a similar vessel of her length.
source_quote: A pilot vessel when not engaged on pilotage duty shall exhibit the lights or shapes prescribed for a similar vessel of her length.

question: Under the Inland Rules, why may the towing vessel direct a searchlight in the direction of the tow?
expected_answer: To indicate its presence to an approaching vessel.
source_quote: The towing vessel may direct a searchlight in the direction of the tow to indicate its presence to an approaching vessel.
